profile.name: Bunda Economics Association
profile.heroTitle: Research for a more resilient tomorrow.
profile.heroCopy: We are a student-led research community turning economic inquiry into practical insight for agriculture, the environment and communities in Malawi.
profile.aboutCopy: The BEA Research Team is the research arm of the Bunda Economics Association at LUANAR’s Bunda Campus. We bring together ambitious students to investigate the questions that matter to Malawi’s economy, agriculture and environment.

research.title: Resilient value chains for smallholder agriculture
research.summary: Examining pathways to more productive, inclusive agricultural markets.

research.title: Resource stewardship and rural resilience
research.summary: Exploring economic incentives that support sustainable environmental practice.

research.title: Skills, opportunity & the next generation
research.summary: Understanding how practical research training shapes student employability.

news.summary: Following the recent debate with the University of Zambia, LUANAR emerged victorious. Precious Mchepa of BEA was recognised as overall best speaker, alongside fellow BEA members Eunice Chibvumbe and Michael Greciam Lunduka.
